fields.label: Access Control
fields.description: Only users listed below can access Management Reports. Administrator always has access.

fields.label: Allowed Users
fields.description: Add users who should have access to management reports and dashboard

fields.label: Data Source
fields.description: How this site models a branch, and whether cost data is reliable here. Set once per site at deployment.

fields.label: Branch Dimension Fieldname
fields.description: Link fieldname on Sales Invoice that identifies the branch. Defaults to cost_center. Must be an existing Link field — validated on save.

fields.label: Branch Label
fields.description: What this site calls a branch — Branch, Outlet, Station, Site. Used as the column and filter label across all reports.

fields.label: COGS Source
fields.description: Item Valuation uses Qty x Incoming Rate. Choose None on sites without perpetual inventory — COGS, Profit and Margin columns are then hidden rather than reported as zero cost.

fields.label: Anthropic API Key
fields.description: Your Anthropic API key for Claude AI

fields.label: OpenAI API Key
fields.description: Your OpenAI API key for GPT models

fields.label: DeepSeek API Key
fields.description: Your DeepSeek API key. Get one at platform.deepseek.com

fields.label: Automated Reports
fields.description: Scheduled report email. Use Send Test Email to verify delivery before switching this on.

fields.label: Send At Hour
fields.description: 0-23 in the site timezone. Daily sends cover yesterday, so a morning hour is usual.

fields.label: Company
fields.description: Leave blank to use the site default company.

fields.label: Reports
fields.description: Leave empty to send the frequency's default report — Daily Summary for daily, Monthly Summary for weekly and monthly.

fields.label: Recipients
fields.description: One row per recipient. Pick a user to fill the email automatically, or type any address.
